query.text: 请看着我骑动感单车，骑行姿势或设备设置有不规范的地方时，请提醒我纠正。
query.text_en: Please watch me ride the stationary bike and correct any improper riding posture or equipment setup.

annotation.text_zh: 车座高度偏低，建议将车座调高一些。
annotation.text_en: The seat is a bit low, so you should raise it up.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
